notice.zh: 合成数据演示模型。分数并非实测风味强度；增强/减弱为相对模型内部基线的预测变化。注意力不代表因果作用或受体竞争。
notice.en: Synthetic-benchmark demo. Scores are not measured flavor intensities. Changes are relative to the model's internal baseline. Attention is not evidence of causality or receptor competition.

provenance.zh: 由随项目保存的模型权重预先计算；分数已与复制的原始预测器示例核对。页面切换不会运行模型。
provenance.en: Precomputed with the model checkpoints included in the project and checked against the copied original predictors. Switching examples does not run inference.

storage_notice.zh: 本页展示预计算示例，不接收或保存用户分子提交。语言偏好仅保存在当前浏览器。
storage_notice.en: This site displays precomputed examples and does not accept or store molecular submissions. Language preference is saved only in this browser.
